verses.original: εἰμὶ Οὐκ ἐλεύθερος εἰμὶ οὐκ ἀπόστολος οὐχὶ ἑόρακα Ἰησοῦν ἡμῶν τὸν Κύριον ἐστε ὑμεῖς οὐ τὸ μου ἔργον ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: eimi Ouk eleutheros eimi ouk apostolos ouchi heoraka Iēsoun hēmōn ton Kyrion este hymeis ou to mou ergon en Kyriō
verses.literal: Am I not free Am I not an apostle vvv Have I not seen Jesus our - Lord Are you [yourselves] not - my workmanship in [the] Lord

verses.original: εἰ εἰμὶ οὐκ ἀπόστολος ἄλλοις ἀλλά γε εἰμι ὑμῖν γὰρ ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἡ σφραγίς μου τῆς ἀποστολῆς ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: ei eimi ouk apostolos allois alla ge eimi hymin gar hymeis este hē sphragis mou tēs apostolēs en Kyriō
verses.literal: Even if I am not an apostle to others vvv surely I am to you For you are the seal of my - apostleship in [the] Lord

verses.original: αὕτη ἐστιν Ἡ ἐμὴ ἀπολογία τοῖς ἀνακρίνουσίν ἐμὲ
verses.transliteration: hautē estin Hē emē apologia tois anakrinousin eme
verses.literal: This is - my defense to those who scrutinize me

verses.original: ἔχομεν μὴ οὐκ ἐξουσίαν φαγεῖν καὶ πεῖν
verses.transliteration: echomen mē ouk exousian phagein kai pein
verses.literal: Have we no . . . right to food and to drink

verses.original: ἔχομεν μὴ οὐκ ἐξουσίαν περιάγειν ἀδελφὴν γυναῖκα ὡς καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ τοῦ Κυρίου ἀδελφοὶ καὶ Κηφᾶς
verses.transliteration: echomen mē ouk exousian periagein adelphēn gynaika hōs kai hoi loipoi apostoloi kai hoi tou Kyriou adelphoi kai Kēphas
verses.literal: Have we no . . . right to take along a believing wife as [do] the other apostles and the vvv Lord’s brothers and Cephas

verses.original: ἢ Βαρνάβας καὶ ἐγὼ μόνος οὐκ ἔχομεν ἐξουσίαν μὴ ἐργάζεσθαι
verses.transliteration: ē Barnabas kai egō monos ouk echomen exousian mē ergazesthai
verses.literal: Or {are} Barnabas and I the only [ apostles ] who must . . . . . . . . . work for a living

verses.original: Τίς ποτέ στρατεύεται ἰδίοις ὀψωνίοις τίς φυτεύει ἀμπελῶνα καὶ οὐκ ἐσθίει αὐτοῦ τὸν καρπὸν ἢ τίς ποιμαίνει ποίμνην καὶ οὐκ ἐσθίει ἐκ τῆς ποίμνης τοῦ γάλακτος
verses.transliteration: Tis pote strateuetai idiois opsōniois tis phyteuei ampelōna kai ouk esthiei autou ton karpon ē tis poimainei poimnēn kai ouk esthiei ek tēs poimnēs tou galaktos
verses.literal: Who - serves as a soldier at his own expense Who plants a vineyard and vvv does not eat of its - fruit - Who tends a flock and vvv does not drink of vvv [its] - milk

verses.original: Μὴ λαλῶ ταῦτα κατὰ ἄνθρωπον ἢ ὁ οὐ νόμος καὶ λέγει ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Mē lalō tauta kata anthrōpon ē ho ou nomos kai legei tauta
verses.literal: vvv Do I say this from a human perspective . . . - - Doesn’t [the] Law - say the same thing

verses.original: γὰρ γέγραπται ἐν τῷ νόμῳ Μωϋσέως Οὐ κημώσεις βοῦν ἀλοῶντα μὴ τῶν βοῶν τῷ Θεῷ μέλει
verses.transliteration: gar gegraptai en tō nomō Mōuseōs Ou kēmōseis boun aloōnta mē tōn boōn tō Theō melei
verses.literal: For it is written in the Law of Moses vvv Do not muzzle an ox [while it is] treading out the grain [Is it] about oxen - [that] God is concerned

verses.original: ἢ λέγει πάντως δι’ ἡμᾶς γὰρ ἐγράφη δι’ ἡμᾶς ὅτι ὁ ἀροτριῶν ἀροτριᾶν ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι καὶ ὁ ἀλοῶν ὀφείλει ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι τοῦ μετέχειν
verses.transliteration: ē legei pantōs di’ hēmas gar egraphē di’ hēmas hoti ho arotriōn arotrian ep’ elpidi kai ho aloōn opheilei ep’ elpidi tou metechein
verses.literal: Isn’t He actually speaking . . . on our behalf . . . Indeed this was written for us because [when] the plowman plows - - and the thresher [ threshes ] [they] should vvv [also] expect - to share in the harvest

verses.original: Εἰ ἡμεῖς ἐσπείραμεν τὰ πνευματικὰ ὑμῖν μέγα εἰ ἡμεῖς θερίσομεν τὰ σαρκικὰ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ei hēmeis espeiramen ta pneumatika hymin mega ei hēmeis therisomen ta sarkika hymōn
verses.literal: If we have sown - spiritual [seed] among you [is it] too much vvv for us to reap - a material [harvest] from you

verses.original: εἰ ἄλλοι μετέχουσιν τῆς ἐξουσίας ὑμῶν οὐ ἡμεῖς μᾶλλον ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐχρησάμεθα ταύτῃ τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ ἀλλὰ στέγομεν πάντα ἵνα μή δῶμεν τινα ἐνκοπὴν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ei alloi metechousin tēs exousias hymōn ou hēmeis mallon all’ ouk echrēsametha tautē tē exousia alla stegomen panta hina mē dōmen tina enkopēn tō euangeliō tou Christou
verses.literal: If others have [this] right to your [support] shouldn’t we [have it] all the more But vvv we did not exercise this - right Instead we put up with anything rather than . . . hinder . . . . . . the gospel of Christ

verses.original: Οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὰ ἱερὰ ἐσθίουσιν τὰ ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ οἱ παρεδρεύοντες τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ συμμερίζονται τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Ouk oidate hoti hoi ergazomenoi ta hiera esthiousin ta ek tou hierou hoi paredreuontes tō thysiastēriō symmerizontai tō thysiastēriō
verses.literal: vvv Do you not know that those who work in the temple eat of [its food] . . . . . . . . . [and] those who serve at the altar partake of [its] [offerings]

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὁ Κύριος διέταξεν τοῖς καταγγέλλουσιν τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ζῆν ἐκ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai ho Kyrios dietaxen tois katangellousin to euangelion zēn ek tou euangeliou
verses.literal: In the same way . . . the Lord has prescribed that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel

verses.original: δὲ ἐγὼ οὐ κέχρημαι οὐδενὶ τούτων δὲ οὐκ ἔγραψα ταῦτα ἵνα οὕτως γένηται ἐν ἐμοί γάρ μοι μᾶλλον καλὸν ἀποθανεῖν ἢ οὐδεὶς κενώσει μου τὸ καύχημά
verses.transliteration: de egō ou kechrēmai oudeni toutōn de ouk egrapsa tauta hina houtōs genētai en emoi gar moi mallon kalon apothanein ē oudeis kenōsei mou to kauchēma
verses.literal: But I vvv have not used [any] of these [rights] And vvv I am not writing this to suggest that something be done for me Indeed I would rather . . . die than {let} anyone nullify my - boast

verses.original: γὰρ Ἐὰν εὐαγγελίζωμαι μοι ἔστιν οὐκ καύχημα γάρ μοι ἀνάγκη ἐπίκειται γάρ οὐαὶ ἐστιν μοί ἐὰν μὴ εὐαγγελίσωμαι
verses.transliteration: gar Ean euangelizōmai moi estin ouk kauchēma gar moi anankē epikeitai gar ouai estin moi ean mē euangelisōmai
verses.literal: Yet when I preach the gospel I have no reason to boast because I am obligated [to preach] . . . - Woe - to me if vvv I do not preach the gospel

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ πράσσω τοῦτο ἑκὼν ἔχω μισθὸν δὲ εἰ ἄκων πεπίστευμαι οἰκονομίαν
verses.transliteration: gar ei prassō touto hekōn echō misthon de ei akōn pepisteumai oikonomian
verses.literal: - If my [preaching] [is] voluntary I have a reward But if [it is] not voluntary I am [still] entrusted with [a] responsibility

verses.original: τίς οὖν ἐστιν μού ὁ μισθός ἵνα εὐαγγελιζόμενος θήσω τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἀδάπανον εἰς μὴ τὸ καταχρήσασθαι μου τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ
verses.transliteration: tis oun estin mou ho misthos hina euangelizomenos thēsō to euangelion adapanon eis mē to katachrēsasthai mou tē exousia en tō euangeliō
verses.literal: What then is my - reward That in preaching the gospel I may offer - [it] free of charge and so not - use up my - rights in [preaching] [it]

verses.original: γὰρ ὢν Ἐλεύθερος ἐκ πάντων ἐδούλωσα ἐμαυτὸν πᾶσιν ἵνα κερδήσω τοὺς πλείονας
verses.transliteration: gar ōn Eleutheros ek pantōn edoulōsa emauton pasin hina kerdēsō tous pleionas
verses.literal: Though I am free of obligation to anyone I make myself a slave . . . to everyone to win - as many as possible

verses.original: καὶ τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ἐγενόμην ὡς Ἰουδαῖος ἵνα κερδήσω Ἰουδαίους τοῖς ὑπὸ νόμον ὡς ὑπὸ νόμον αὐτὸς ὢν μὴ ὑπὸ νόμον ἵνα κερδήσω τοὺς ὑπὸ νόμον
verses.transliteration: kai tois Ioudaiois egenomēn hōs Ioudaios hina kerdēsō Ioudaious tois hypo nomon hōs hypo nomon autos ōn mē hypo nomon hina kerdēsō tous hypo nomon
verses.literal: - To the Jews I became like a Jew to win [the] Jews To those under [the] law [I became like one] under [the] law ([though I] myself am not under [the] law) to win those under [the] law

verses.original: τοῖς ἀνόμοις ὡς ἄνομος ὢν μὴ ἄνομος Θεοῦ ἀλλ’ ἔννομος Χριστοῦ ἵνα κερδάνω τοὺς ἀνόμους
verses.transliteration: tois anomois hōs anomos ōn mē anomos Theou all’ ennomos Christou hina kerdanō tous anomous
verses.literal: To those without [the] law [I became like one] without [the] law ([though I] am not outside [the] law of God but [am] under [the] law of Christ) to win those without [the] law

verses.original: τοῖς ἀσθενέσιν ἐγενόμην ἀσθενής ἵνα κερδήσω τοὺς ἀσθενεῖς γέγονα πάντα τοῖς πᾶσιν ἵνα πάντως σώσω τινὰς
verses.transliteration: tois asthenesin egenomēn asthenēs hina kerdēsō tous astheneis gegona panta tois pasin hina pantōs sōsō tinas
verses.literal: To the weak I became weak to win the weak I have become all things to all [people] so that by all possible means I might save some

verses.original: δὲ ποιῶ Πάντα διὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἵνα γένωμαι συνκοινωνὸς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: de poiō Panta dia to euangelion hina genōmai synkoinōnos autou
verses.literal: - I do all [this] for the sake of the gospel so that I may share . . . in its [blessings]

verses.original: Οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ἐν σταδίῳ μὲν πάντες οἱ τρέχοντες τρέχουσιν δὲ εἷς λαμβάνει τὸ βραβεῖον τρέχετε οὕτως ἵνα καταλάβητε
verses.transliteration: Ouk oidate hoti en stadiō men pantes hoi trechontes trechousin de heis lambanei to brabeion trechete houtōs hina katalabēte
verses.literal: vvv Do you not know that in a race - all the runners run but only one receives the prize Run in such a way as to take [the prize]

verses.original: δὲ πᾶς ὁ ἀγωνιζόμενος ἐγκρατεύεται πάντα οὖν μὲν ἐκεῖνοι ἵνα λάβωσιν στέφανον φθαρτὸν δὲ ἡμεῖς ἄφθαρτον
verses.transliteration: de pas ho agōnizomenos enkrateuetai panta oun men ekeinoi hina labōsin stephanon phtharton de hēmeis aphtharton
verses.literal: - Everyone who competes in the games trains with strict discipline . . . - - They [do it] vvv [for] a crown [that is] perishable but we [ do it for a crown ] [that is] imperishable

verses.original: τοίνυν ἐγὼ τρέχω οὐκ οὕτως ὡς ἀδήλως πυκτεύω οὐκ οὕτως ὡς δέρων ἀέρα
verses.transliteration: toinyn egō trechō ouk houtōs hōs adēlōs pykteuō ouk houtōs hōs derōn aera
verses.literal: Therefore I do not run . . . vvv vvv aimlessly I do not fight . . . like . . . I am beating [the] air

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ὑπωπιάζω μου τὸ σῶμα καὶ δουλαγωγῶ κηρύξας ἄλλοις αὐτὸς μή πως γένωμαι ἀδόκιμος
verses.transliteration: alla hypōpiazō mou to sōma kai doulagōgō kēryxas allois autos mē pōs genōmai adokimos
verses.literal: No I discipline my - body and make it my slave [so that] after I have preached to others I myself vvv vvv will not be disqualified
